prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to move the test tube from capping device to shaking device.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: shaking device
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is a capped test tube on shaking device.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A narrow laboratory aisle viewed lengthwise. The left half is dominated by a large pale panel/wall with dark clamp blocks along its lower edge. In the centre foreground, a white benchtop carries a black rectangular instrument housing mounted on grey aluminium posts with silver screws; behind it stands a capped tube or bottle with an orange-red cap, upright. Further back are white boxed enclosures, a white tray or basin, black equipment with a dark cable, a blue unit, and a rack of vertical pipettes or columns against a white cabinet. At right, extruded aluminium rails and a black post, plus a green-capped container upright on a shelf. Overhead, a long fluorescent strip light, ceiling ducts and hangers; a bright window at the far left.
observations: A capped tube with an orange-red cap is observed standing upright on the benchtop near the instrument housing, confirming the presence of the capped test tube on the shaking device.
